protocol_conflicts: PB-A explicitly requests >=20 US episodes and a bounded pilot; parent W1 preregistration requests 40–60 cross-family episodes before its full comparison. This is PB-A's narrower feasibility pilot, not W1 completion or the parent confirmatory comparison.
sample_design: Fixed purposive 24-event methodological casebook, selected for instrument and regime diversity, not a complete event census or prevalence sample. Researchers already know historical events; no claim of outcome-blind research.

split.honesty: No training, optimization or real unseen holdout. Chronological reporting subset remains retrospectively reconstructed.

primary_target.name: fed_target_midpoint_net_direction
primary_target.definition: Sign of effective target midpoint on the calendar horizon date minus the most recently decided target midpoint known by the episode cut. A just-announced rate decision is absorbed into the anchor; its next-day effective change is not counted as a successful forecast.
primary_target.endpoint_time: End of the horizon date in America/New_York; effective daily rate from DFEDTARU/DFEDTARL.
primary_target.missing_policy: Unavailable anchor/outcome => NOT_SCORED; never substitute zero.

secondary_policy_target.name: first_subsequent_rate_change_within_horizon
secondary_policy_target.definition: Direction of first target change DECIDED strictly after cut and effective by horizon; HOLD if none. Exclude the already-known event decision. Report separately from net movement; requires decision/effective-date reconciliation.

M0.name: LITERAL
M0.rule: Faithfully code a clean explicit contemporaneous forward rate path as UP/DOWN/HOLD. Do not turn an inflation goal, justification, generic readiness, funding change or liquidity support into a rate forecast. Vague two-sided guidance or no clean rate implication => ABSTAIN. Conditional forward guidance must retain conditions. Same directional signal is extrapolated to each horizon as an explicitly assumed baseline; it is not a claim the official promised that horizon.

M1.name: INVERTED
M1.rule: UP<->DOWN from M0. M0 HOLD has two possible opposites, so ABSTAIN; M0 ABSTAIN => ABSTAIN.

M2.name: ACTIONS_CONSTRAINTS_MINIMAL
M2.rule: For a new FOMC/Fed policy-rate decision: continue the sign of the known DECIDED rate change; a rate hold => HOLD. At a newly decided conventional 0–0.25% floor, a cut => HOLD, under the explicitly stated conventional-floor assumption. If the event makes no new rate decision, ABSTAIN. Balance-sheet changes, liquidity support, Treasury funding composition and speeches are not automatically mapped into Fed rate changes.
M2.scope: A deliberately minimal action-plus-institutional-constraint implementation of M2. Qualitative motives, beneficiaries and feasible alternatives are recorded but never inserted into its predictions. Does not test every possible richer M2 model.

C0.name: NO_CHANGE_INSTITUTIONAL_NULL
C0.rule: Always HOLD when the rate anchor is available; identical probability convention. Separately reported comparator, not a replacement for M0/M1/M2.

C1.name: UNCONSTRAINED_ACTION_ABLATION
C1.rule: M2 without the conventional-floor exception; action-only continuation. Separately reported to isolate the floor assumption.

metrics.comparisons: Pairwise/common coverage only, alongside each model's own coverage. Do not compare unpaired accuracy as skill.
metrics.uncertainty: Cluster block bootstrap paired score differences by four prespecified historical regimes; report sensitivity rather than formal evidence of generalization with only four clusters. Leave-one-regime-out summaries; no horizon pooling.
metrics.calibration: Reliability summary only; calibration slope unavailable for a fixed modal probability, no fitted calibration claim.

other_target_rule: Record target-specific observed outcomes if admissible data are available, but abstain unless each model has a clean separately frozen target forecast. Missing archived expectations, DXY rights/series, or transmission mapping are explicit target-level gaps; do not pool them with policy accuracy.
leakage_contract: Predictor accepts a narrow decision-time feature object only, not outcomes, retrospective outcome histories, future revisions, or the full row. Forecast artifact is frozen before outcome join. All input source time upper bounds <= cut. Corrections, mutable links, and date-only uncertainties retained. Historical documentary certification is not contemporaneous archived byte certification.
result_gate: Complete >=20 historically source-time-certified rows with explicit certification scope, runnable pilot or named target-level data deficiencies, exact lineage and honest limitations. No live inference, rank, gate, size, trading, merger or deployment.
